claims.excerpt: De James Webb-ruimtetelescoop moest opgevouwen in de neuskegel van de Ariane 5 passen.

claims.sourceEvidence: “Webb's fully deployed operational configuration is far too large to fit into any available rocket so it was designed to fold into a compact launch configuration that fit inside the Ariane 5.”

claims.narrativeStatement: “Webb was ontworpen om opgevouwen in de Ariane 5-raket te passen”
claims.explanation: Faithfully conveys the launch constraint and the foldable design; the source also identifies the fairing as the rocket’s nose cone.
